description.zh: 拖着蘸了颜料的车轮滚一圈，量出这条线有多长。换三种大小的轮子比一比，圆周率 π 会自己从你的记录表里冒出来。再把圆切成小片拼成长方形，就看懂了圆面积公式 πr²。
description.en: Roll a paint-dipped wheel one full turn and measure the line it paints. Compare three wheel sizes and π emerges from your own data table. Then slice a circle and rebuild it as a rectangle to see where area = πr² comes from.
